claims.location: source name, comment[data file], comment[technical replicate] rows 1-14
claims.value: four TNH2 runs, two medieval reference runs, four extraction blanks, four MS blanks
claims.evidence: The deposited key groups unique run suffixes: TNH2 HCl 1686_01/02; TNH2 TFA 1687_01/02; extraction blank HCl 1688_01/02 and TFA 1689_01/02; reference 1692/1693; MS blanks 01/03/04/06. PRIDE lists exactly the corresponding 14 RAW files. TNH2 and the medieval reference each retain one biological source across HCl and TFA preparations. The TNH2 acquisition indices are 1-4 across the two preparations, and the reference acquisition indices are 1-2; paired _01/_02 acquisitions of a single extraction retain their relative order.

claims.value: HCl or TFA enamel extraction; not applicable for MS blanks
claims.evidence: The deposited filename key explicitly labels TNH2 and extraction blank HCl/TFA groups and reference 1692/1693 as HCl/TFA. PRIDE sample protocol gives 1.5 M HCl and 0.88 M TFA demineralization. MS blanks have no extraction.

claims.value: TNH2 Homo fossil enamel; male Homo sapiens medieval reference; blanks not applicable
claims.evidence: PRIDE identifies taxon Homo and tooth enamel for the deposit; filename key identifies TNH2 and medieval reference runs. The article identifies reference Ø1952 as male Homo sapiens. TNH2 sex and species remain unassigned in the SDRF.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method]
claims.value: Q Exactive HF-X, top-10 DDA, HCD
claims.evidence: PRIDE instrument field is MS:1002877; sample protocol details top-10 DDA and HCD at NCE 28, matching the article.
PRIDE processing protocol describes direct enamel demineralization, peptide desalting and an unspecific database search; no proteolytic digestion reagent is used.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: The accession processing protocol describes MaxQuant search strategy but does not give numerical precursor or fragment search tolerances.

limitations: The older medieval reference RAW files are included in this accession's file list and current MaxQuant search, but PRIDE notes they were first analysed in PXD014342.
TNH2 is annotated at the PRIDE taxon Homo level; the article's Denisovan interpretation is not treated as a species assignment for these runs.

The deposited filename key does not state whether the paired _01/_02 acquisitions are reinjections; they are recorded as technical replicates of each named extraction based on the common sample ID and distinct acquisition suffixes.
No numerical mass tolerances are supplied in the accession protocol; these remain not available.
